children: Overview
UK self-storage operator's Q3 group revenue rose 4.1% at constant exchange rates
Like-for-like revenue up 1.9%, with UK and expansion markets offsetting Paris decline
Company expects FY 2026 adjusted EPS in lower half of analyst forecast range
Outlook
Safestore expects FY 2026 Adjusted Diluted EPRA EPS in the lower half of analyst forecast range
Company says FY 2026 store openings remain unchanged
Safestore is reviewing 2027-28 UK pipeline phasing due to current macroeconomic and interest rate environment
Result Drivers
EXPANSION MARKETS - Strong revenue growth in Spain, the Netherlands and Belgium, driven by both occupancy and rate increases
PARIS PERFORMANCE - Like-for-like Paris revenue declined due to transfer of enquiries to new stores and lower occupancy in large units amid subdued economic backdrop
UK GROWTH DRIVERS - Like-for-like UK revenue up 1.9%, supported by domestic customer demand and unit partitioning
